entities.text: Court of Additional Sessions Judge II, Purnea
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5 It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that initially petitioner has been convicted by the learned SDJM, Purnea for the offence punishable under Section Patna High Court CR.

REV.
No.466 of 2024(4) dt.11-07-2024 498A of IPC and Sections
of Dowry Prohibition Act
and was sentenced to undergo simple imprisonment for two years and six months respectively.

The appellate Court, i e, Additional Sessions Judge II, Purnea upheld the conviction of the petitioner in Appeal Case No 26 of 2022 and directed the petitioner to surrender before the Court below within 30 days.
As per the direction given by the learned Additional Sessions Judge II, Purnea, the petitioner surrendered on 21.05.2024 and since then he is in jail.
It is further submitted that the petitioner is having some neurological problem and, therefore, he is required to be regular check up from the concerned doctor.
He lastly submits that the revision petition will take much time to finalize.

Therefore, it is prayed by the learned counsel for the petitioner that considering all the above Ashish Kumar Srivastava vs The State Of Bihar on 11 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49885505/
1 aspects of the matter, the petitioner be granted the benefit of bail and the sentence be suspended.

sentences.text: The prayer made by the learned counsel for the petitioner is opposed by the learned counsel for the State.

7 Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is in jail since 21.05.2024 and he is also suffering from some neurological disease and that the revision petition will take time to finalize, I Patna High Court CR. REV. No.466 of 2024(4) dt.11-07-2024 am inclined to allow the prayer for bail and suspend the sentence.

8 Accordingly, let the petitioner above named be released on bail on his furnishing bonds of Rs 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of SDJM, Purnea in Complaint Case No 2377 of 2009.
9 Realization of fine shall also remain stayed during pendency of this revision petition.

(Arvind Singh Chandel, J) M.E.H./-
